text_block_list.text:
The New Year of the Senior Year had 
finally arrived. I went for the first 
shrine visit of the year with Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... As it is every year, it's 
wonderfully lively this time around too."
choice_data_list:
The line to pray was quite long, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The queue went all the way past the 
torii gate... Due to how the line formed, 
I felt rather awkward having to stand 
right in the center of the approach.
choice_data_list:
It was certainly a bit awkward, wasn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even so, considering the circumstances... 
I can only hope God will forgive us.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, speaking of forgiveness... Since 
the line behind me was backing up, I 
rushed to keep my prayer short.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I totally stumbled over my greeting in my 
head.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, we cannot start over now... 
Would you be able to forgive us...?"

And with that, having successfully 
finished our New Year's shrine visit, our 
next destination was—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: A-Happy-New-Yeeeeaaar!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, cheers!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Well then, let's get right down to 
it! Our New Year's party, that is!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I look forward to working with you. 
Thank you very much for inviting me today.

Bowing alongside Air Messiah, I take 
another look around. Her close classmates 
are all gathered here, but—
choice_data_list: Was it really okay for me to join in...?

I... I wonder if I should have joined 
in...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That's so typical of Messiah's 
Trainer! You really are serious to a 
fault.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry about that! Parties are 
way more fun when they're lively♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Also, Craft and I prepared the sweets and 
dishes, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was so, so excited for today that I 
ended up making way too much!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please don't be shy and eat 
plenty too—it'd really help me out!
choice_data_list: I-I see... Got it, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.text:
I can't possibly match the Umamusume's 
hearty appetites, but every little bit 
helps. I psyched myself up to do my part 
and cooperate.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, I'll go heat up the 
sea bream en croûte in the kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Sea bream...! My, how extravagant. I'm 
truly looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right, right~! I'll bring them 
fresh out of the oven, so just wait a 
little bit!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! The oven isn't working, you saaaay?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me...! What happened to the 
oven?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Craft-chan and the others! Come to 
think of it, you did mention you'd be 
using it today, didn't you...?"

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
"Still, sorry about this. For some reason, 
it suddenly won't budge an inch."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... You're right. Nothing happens even 
when I press the button.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's not that... it's unplugged or 
anything. The power light is on, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
"Well, we're in a bit of a pickle~! The 
cafeteria is closed for the academy's 
winter break, so the other ovens are being 
cleaned right now—"

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
This is the only one working right now. 
Sorry, Heart-chan and everyone, what 
should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Um. From what I can see, isn't this 
oven the same model as the one in the dorm 
kitchen?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yeah, I'm pretty sure that was 
the case.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. In that case, um...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Found it. Heart-san, please operate the 
controls exactly as I instruct from here 
on.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Press "Start" and "Menu" at the same time, 
then push "Cancel" three times.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What...? Hmm... Like this, perhaps?
(Beep-beep-beep!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? It started moving... !?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha-what!? Why!? Is it magic!? A 
spell!? A ritual...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, it is not like that. I merely went 
through the procedure to unlock 
operations.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the procedure to lock it is 
the same, so... it seems a series of 
coincidences led to those inputs being 
made just now.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
C-Control lock? There's a feature like 
that?! I've worked here for a long time, 
but this is the first I've heard of it...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When I moved into the dorm, I checked the 
kitchen equipment manuals and downloaded 
electronic copies as well... If they were 
of help, then nothing could please me 
more.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You read all the equipment manuals?! 
Th-That's incredible...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The dorm serves breakfast and dinner on 
days off, but we have to arrange lunch on 
our own, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I might be using the kitchen to 
cook for myself... so I figured I should 
start by thoroughly reading the manual."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I looked through it for the same reason, 
but maybe I didn't catch things in quite 
that much detail...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"This—braces me right at the start of the 
new year. Let me take you as an example, 
Messiah-san."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, well, isn't that a bit of an 
exaggeration...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Good grief, Trainer. At least from 
you, I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't 
take that attitude."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you read the manual for the 
equipment in the trainer's office with me 
from cover to cover?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Well, well. In short—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You two really are like "The Messiah and 
Her Trainer," aren't you!

And so, after successfully enjoying 
piping-hot sea bream wrapped in pastry and 
having a good time at the New Year's 
party—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd even get movie coupons 
as a thank-you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks to Messiah-san, this turned 
into an incredibly fulfilling New Year♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When you think of the new year, it's a 
season with a rich harvest of exciting 
movies, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it looks like there are still 
seats available. Now then, which one 
should we go with!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Trainer, is there a 
particular movie that catches your eye?

As I hesitated, Rhein Kraft and the others 
each shared their movie recommendations 
with me. If I had to choose from them—
choice_data_list: Hilarious Twist♪ 'Fly Me to West Tokyo'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That one was... if I recall, proposed by 
Craft-san."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a fantasy movie! It's such a 
warm, heartwarming story full of dreams~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's based on a children's novel, and 
Sweep-san recommended it to me♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see. If it's a recommendation from that 
little witch, then...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I can't help but be intrigued 
myself.

And so, I enjoyed a magical fantasy movie 
alongside Rhein Kraft and the others.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Even without you offering, I 
understand. As for this—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Yes♪ It's my recommendation, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Heart has introduced us to a variety 
of shark movies in the past, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"A chainsaw on the head this time... is 
it? Quite the product of a terrifying 
imagination."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
True! That's precisely why you get thrills 
that defy expectations. That's the real 
charm of this kind of movie!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone, ready? Let's go 
experience some uncharted thrills!

And so, through the movie Daring Heart 
recommended, I got to experience an 
unknown... far too unknown rollercoaster 
of plot twists.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Fly? If it's West Tokyo... does that 
mean Fuchu, where Tracen Academy is, as 
well...?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, who knows? Let's definitely go find 
out!
choice_data_list:
So you like this kind of thing, 
Cesario...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I actually quite enjoy comedies♪ 
People are often surprised when I tell 
them that, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... when we had a 
movie night in our dorm room, Cesario 
brought a comedy film too, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it's not a genre I watch 
very often, so I was a bit on guard at 
first... but I thoroughly enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to this time as 
well. Shall we get going, then?

Cesario's recommended movie wasn't just 
enjoyable, but surprisingly 
profound—making for a truly wonderful 
watch—

...Not that I actually flew at Fuchu, 
though.
